extracted.intended_audience: corporate communicators, crisis PR professionals, and business leaders interested in reputation management
extracted.subtask_short: crisis PR for large product recalls
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and evaluative criteria for corporate communications teams handling a large-scale consumer-product recall (logistics, messaging, regulator/retailer engagement, and reputation repair). Useful for PR pros planning or assessing recall response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness and decisiveness of initial response
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Initially, Samsung was praised for its fast and decisive reaction to the reports.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fast, decisive action is evaluated positively; early visible steps (e.g., announcing a recall) can limit immediate damage. However, early speed must be followed by sustained follow-up (see timelines/updates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of specific timelines and ongoing updates to consumers
rubrics_metrics.description: The company 'has yet to provide consumers with a specific timeline on when they might expect replacements for their recalled handsets.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicators should give clear, specific timelines for remedy (replacements/repairs) and keep customers updated; lack of timeline undermines trust even if initial action was fast.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supply sufficiency and logistics coordination at scale
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Such a massive recall comes with predictable challenges of having enough supply and coordinating the logistics of replacing millions of phones across continents.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate operational readiness: inventory availability, distribution plans, cross-border logistics, and capacity to handle replacements globally. Failure here delays remediation and worsens reputational harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity of messaging and providing customers peace of mind
rubrics_metrics.description: The need to 'provide clarity and piece of mind to customers on such a massive scale.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess message clarity, consistency, tone (reassuring vs. defensive), channels used, and whether communications address customer safety concerns directly to restore confidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical resolution of the underlying safety issue
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Samsung needs to take steps to resolve the issues surrounding the battery.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond communications, the company must identify and fix the root cause (e.g., battery defects). Effective PR depends on demonstrable technical remediation and transparent reporting of those fixes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement with regulators and retailers to ensure compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: 'engage more closely with government regulators and retailers, some of whom were still selling defective phones days after the recall announcement.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure outreach to and coordination with regulators and retail partners, speed of enforcement/withdrawal from shelves, and proactive steps to prevent continued sales of defective products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive, long-term reputation-rebuilding strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: The communications team will need to 'deploy a comprehensive PR strategy in the coming months aimed at regaining consumers’ confidence and trust.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate plans for sustained reputation repair: advertising, earned media, customer restitution programs, third‑party endorsements/audits, and metrics for measuring trust recovery over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Context sensitivity: managing timing relative to competitors and seasonality
rubrics_metrics.description: The crisis 'couldn’t have come at a worse time ... Apple unveiled its newest flagship iPhone 7 ... As the holiday season is rapidly approaching.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how the response accounts for market timing, competitor activity, and seasonal buying cycles; messaging and remediation should factor in these external pressures to minimize competitive damage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall effectiveness of the PR team in determining reputation rebound
rubrics_metrics.description: 'how fast the company’s reputation will be able to rebound from the ongoing crisis will depend largely on the effectiveness of its PR team.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use outcome-oriented metrics (brand perception surveys, sales recovery, media sentiment, market value stabilization) to judge whether PR actions successfully restore reputation.
